title: Expired shares continue to disclose documents

trace.description: Authenticated GET /documents/{doc_id} accepts caller-controlled document ID
Bob can read Alice's document after the share expires. The original read predicate checks revocation but never expires_at.
Returns full document JSON across the access boundary

evidence.description: Original requests return 200 and Synthetic alpha; fixed requests return 404.
Regression checks fail before the fix and pass after.

counterevidence: The creation endpoint requires a future expiry and the read predicate rejects revoked shares. Neither enforces time at subsequent reads.

likelihood.reason: Requires a previously granted relationship followed by expiry or membership change.

impact.reason: Fully defeats explicit document confidentiality control; returns entire protected document.

conditions.description: Authenticated recipient with an unrevoked share whose expiry has passed

ext.description: Bob can read Alice's document after the share expires. The original read predicate checks revocation but never expires_at.
ext.remediation: Read policy now requires current tenant membership before ownership/share checks, and an unrevoked share strictly before expires_at.

title: Migrated owners and recipients retain old-tenant document access

trace.description: Authenticated GET /documents/{doc_id} accepts caller-controlled document ID
After the trusted directory moves Alice or Bob to south, GET /documents/a still returns the north document. The original read policy ignores current tenant membership.
Returns full document JSON across the access boundary

evidence.description: Original requests return 200 and Synthetic alpha; fixed requests return 404.
Regression checks fail before the fix and pass after.

counterevidence: Sharing and revocation require current tenant membership; inventory filters by current tenant. Those sibling controls do not run on document reads.

likelihood.reason: Requires a previously granted relationship followed by expiry or membership change.

impact.reason: Fully defeats explicit document confidentiality control; returns entire protected document.

conditions.description: Trusted directory changes current membership; attacker does not control that operation

ext.description: After the trusted directory moves Alice or Bob to south, GET /documents/a still returns the north document. The original read policy ignores current tenant membership.
ext.remediation: Read policy now requires current tenant membership before ownership/share checks, and an unrevoked share strictly before expires_at.
